chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah and 'Abd Allah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother 'Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام passed away when he was fifty-seven years old, in the year ninety-five. He lived for thirty-five years after al-Husayn عليه السلام.

key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death

ai.seo_question: When did Imam 'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام pass away, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This hadith records the age and year of the passing of Imam 'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليه السلام. It also states how many years he lived after Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام, preserving a concise biographical detail within the hadith tradition.
